summary: A campaign's lawyer answers an unreported-gift penalty by saying the campaign fixed it when told and meant to hide nothing.
realLife: After a state commission issued late-reporting penalties on a mayor's campaign, its lawyer said the campaign learned of the problems when a rival's complaint arrived, corrected them, and had no intent to obscure.
sources: Anchorage Daily News, state fines mayor for campaign finance violations, Aug. 9, 2021: https://adn.com/alaska-news/anchorage/2021/08/09/state-fines-anchorage-mayor-bronson-33500-for-campaign-finance-violations
inGame: campaign finance filings; a complaint on the record

turns.turn: The lawyer asks the commission to reduce the fine
turns.writesBack: a reduced penalty on the record

turns.turn: The campaign pays and says nothing
turns.pulledBy: a wish to end the story
turns.writesBack: a paid penalty and a short news item
